# Record an animated page section as a GIF artifact.

set-base-url ${BASE_URL}
navigate /screenrecord-basic.html
wait-visible '#box'
screenrecord start recording.gif
sleep 1s
screenrecord stop
stdout 'recording.gif'
# The page animates continuously, so a second of recording yields well over
# ten frames. Chrome stops sending frames that are not acked, which caps a
# broken recorder at about three.
stdout 'frames: [1-9][0-9]+'
